items.expected_conclusion: Within the truncated bpy–FeH2 model and stated thermochemical boundary, the profile supports preferential linear/anti-Markovnikov chemistry and places turnover control at the linear-branch HBpin sigma-bond-metathesis event; this is a model-level mechanistic conclusion, not a full-MOF proof.
